messages:
courtney_docs: We need a short, customer-facing migration guide for the v1 -> v2 API sunset, focused on per-region dates, SDK examples, and a clear redirect map. Can someone own the snippets?

sam_docs: I9ll do JS + Python snippets. Plan to include param mapping table (old -> new) and one streaming example.

rita_eng: I9ll add runtime notes about model fallback behavior and the specific error codes to expect when a pinned model is removed. Will paste a tiny retry example.

courtney_docs: Please include an "Errors & Retry" FAQ: which codes are safe to auto-retry vs which should surface to end users. Also call out embedding dim changes.

sam_docs: Embeddings note: add a short command for reindexing and a link to the reindex guide. I9ll add a troubleshooting subsection.

rita_eng: Runtime snippet for graceful fallback to include: ```
// pseudocode
resp = call_v2(payload)
if resp.code == 404 && resp.detail == "model_unavailable":
  sleep(150)
  resp = call_v2_with_fallback_model(payload)
```

ingrid_release: Ops notes: eu-west dedicated customers have a later freeze—call this out prominently and flag for sales. Also request a docs PR label `sunset/v1`.

sam_docs: Redirect YAML sample to include in PR: ```
- from: "/v1/models/*"
  to: "/v2/models/*"
  status: 301
  scope: region
```

courtney_docs: Good. Also show both old/new param names inline: `model_alias` -> `model`, `stream_eof` -> `meta:event=end`. Add a tiny streaming code example for Node showing the new framing.

sam_docs: Streaming snippet (Node): ```
const stream = client.streaming.chat.connect({ model: 'redwood-1000', messages })
for await (const part of stream) {
  if (part.type === 'token') process.stdout.write(part.text)
  if (part.type === 'meta' && part.meta.event === 'end') console.log('\n-- done --')
}
```

rita_eng: Note: runtime will send `meta:event=end` not EOF sentinel. Add to Breaking Changes section.

alan_support: Please add a short "What to tell customers" blurb for support: one-paragraph summary + links to the migration checklist and sample snippets.

sam_docs: Will add support blurb and a quick checklist: 1) confirm redirect applied, 2) run smoke tests, 3) reindex embeddings if dims differ, 4) update SDK pin.

deploy-bot: deploy/redirects updated by sam_docs 	 preview site: https://docs-preview.internal/redwood/v1-sunset (build 3398).

courtney_docs: Action items recap: sam_docs - open PR with snippets, redirect YAML, embedding note, support blurb; rita_eng - add runtime errors + retry example; ingrid_release - confirm per-region dates and inform sales; courtney_docs - add PR label & smoke-test checklist. Target: merge PR 4 business days before earliest region freeze.

sam_docs: Opening PR now, will post preview link here. :rocket:
